A '''sturdy leather gambeson''' is the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]], crafted from 8 [[sturdy leather]]. Sturdy leather armor is a light set built against arrows and falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}
In 1.12.2, the gambeson found in [[village]] tannery chests was an older, invisible version of the item. The table still gives that older version in 1.12.4, but the pack's [[abandoned village]]s have no loot chests, so it isn't normally found. In the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3, and in the 26.3 port, the tannery table is empty. See [[Sturdy leather armor#Village tannery chests]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives {{Value|Sturdy Leather Gambeson|armor}} armor with {{Value|Sturdy Leather Gambeson|durability}} durability and 2 blocks of safe fall distance, twice what leather gives. Projectile Protection IV comes on the item as an ordinary enchantment.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[tattered leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
